import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Identify significant features (p < 0.05)
    sig_ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) 
               if feats.types[i] != 'derived' and feats.types[i] != 'clinical']
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6)
    to_remove = set()
    
    for i in range(len(sig_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(sig_ids)):
            # Compute correlation between features
            col_i = feats.column(sig_ids[i])
            col_j = feats.column(sig_ids[j])
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_i], feats.x[:, col_j])[0, 1]
            
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                # Remove the less significant one based on t-statistic
                ti = feats.types[i]
                tj = feats.types[j]
                if ti == 'expression' and tj == 'copy_number':
                    to_remove.add(sig_ids[j])
                elif ti == 'copy_number' and tj == 'expression':
                    to_remove.add(sig_ids[i])
                elif ti == 'expression' and tj == 'expression':
                    # Keep the one with higher absolute t-stat
                    t_i = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==0, col_i], 
                                        feats.x[feats.y==1, col_i])[0]
                    t_j = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==0, col_j], 
                                        feats.x[feats.y==1, col_j])[0]
                    if abs(t_i) < abs(t_j):
                        to_remove.add(sig_ids[i])
                    else:
                        to_remove.add(sig_ids[j])
                else:
                    to_remove.add(sig_ids[j])
    
    # Final set of features
    final_ids = [fid for fid in sig_ids if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # If no significant features remain, return empty design
    if not final_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster correlated features
    if len(final_ids) > 1:
        corr_data = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in final_ids]]
        clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, 
                                           distance_threshold=1-0.6, linkage='average')
        clusters = clustering.fit_predict(corr_data.T)
        
        # Select representative from each cluster
        rep_ids = []
        for i in range(max(clusters)+1):
            cluster_features = [final_ids[j] for j in range(len(final_ids)) if clusters[j] == i]
            # Choose the feature with highest absolute t-statistic
            best_fid = max(cluster_features, key=lambda fid: 
                          abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)], 
                                            feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)])[0]))
            rep_ids.append(best_fid)
    else:
        rep_ids = final_ids
    
    # Build design
    drivers = tuple(rep_ids[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    columns = tuple(rep_ids)
    
    # No products needed for this simple approach
    products = ()
    
    # Weighted score: use standardized coefficients from logistic regression
    # Approximate with t-statistics as weights
    loadings = {}
    for fid in rep_ids:
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)], 
                               feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)])[0]
        loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
